```{r setup}
# WEEK is set by the week page that includes this file
source("R/data.R")
source("R/ui.R")

lg  <- load_league()
sc  <- load_scores(lg, WEEK)
wk  <- sc$results %>% filter(week == WEEK)
st  <- build_standings(sc$results, WEEK)
pl  <- sc$players %>% filter(week == WEEK) %>% left_join(lg$teams, by = "franchise_id")
```

## Standings

```{r standings}
standings_html(st, MY_TEAM)
```

## Week `r WEEK` results

```{r results}
results_html(wk, MY_TEAM)
```

## Team of the week

```{r team-of-week}
lineup_html(team_of_week(pl), max(wk$points))
```

::: {.note}
Standings order: F1 points, then average weekly finish, then points for. Team of the week is the best QB, 2 RB, 3 WR, TE and 2 FLEX from every rostered player.
:::
